name: Bit Form – Contact Form, Payment Forms, Multi Step Forms, Calculator & Custom Form Builder
author: Bit Apps

sections.description:
Bit Form WordPress form builder makes form building easy for beginners and flexible for advanced users.

Build mobile-responsive forms with a no-code drag-and-drop builder, powerful features, and highly customizable design controls for any use cases.

You can use Bit Form to build a contact form, support form, lead generation form, registration form, file upload form, order form, booking form, survey form, payment form, calculator form, conversational form, and multistep form from one clean interface.

Bit Form keeps forms lightweight and only loads 20KB JS & CSS for simple contact forms.

Bit Form is built for both beginners and advanced WordPress users. If you need a simple contact form, you can create one quickly.

If you need a complex form with conditional logic, calculations, payment fields, file upload, PDF attachments, email notifications, integrations, and entry management, Bit Form gives you the tools to build it with minimum effort.

Useful Links

Try Demo | Documentation | Bit Form Repository | Youtube Channel | Support Chat | Facebook Community

Features of Bit Form Free Version

Bit Form Free includes:

  • Unlimited forms
  • Unlimited form submissions
  • Drag-and-drop form builder
  • Multi-step forms
  • Show/hide Conditional logic
  • 38+ free form fields
  • Form templates
  • Email templates
  • Email notifications
  • SMTP support
  • Form integrations and webhooks
  • Essential Form styling
  • Responsive forms
  • reCAPTCHA v3
  • reCAPTCHA v2 field
  • hCaptcha field
  • Cloudflare Turnstile field
  • Repeater field
  • Rating field
  • Image select field
  • Hidden field
  • File upload field
  • Custom JS and CSS editor
  • Google Sheets and many other integrations
  • Entry collection inside WordPress

Bit Form V3 Highlights

Bit Form V3 brings a cleaner dashboard, redesigned builder, two-column field list, organized field settings, and an inline Add Field button for faster and easier form creation.

It also adds WordPress multisite support, email OTP verification, responsive preview modes, improved entry filtering, and better export control.

For design, V3 improves the style editor with custom theme management, export/import options, organized style layers, and hover/focus styling.

51 Form Fields Available in Bit Form

Bit Form includes a wide range of form fields for simple and advanced form creation. You can build a basic contact form, detailed application form, payment form, file upload form, multistep form, support form, order form, booking form, and more.

Pro Form Fields

These fields help you create many types of WordPress forms without depending on multiple form plugins.

Bit Form Pro Features

Bit Form Pro is designed for users who need advanced form control, payment collection, user authentication, form abandonment, PDF generation, and more flexible entry management. Bit Form Pro includes:

  • Advanced multi-step form controls
  • Advanced file upload settings
  • Advanced conditional logic
  • Individual field styling
  • Advanced email notifications
  • PDF support in email notifications
  • Email OTP verification
  • Payment fields for PayPal, Razorpay, Stripe, and Mollie
  • API support
  • PDF generation
  • Custom Post Type support
  • Google Ads GCLID capture
  • Form abandonment and partial submission
  • Data views and entry editing
  • Landing form and standalone form pages
  • Custom theme and theme style export/import
  • Double opt-in
  • Multisite support
  • WordPress authentication forms
  • Honeypot spam protection
  • Signature field
  • Shortcode field
  • Draft button field
  • Advanced date-time field

Note: Bit Form Pro is distributed separately from this plugin. The free version of Bit Form is fully functional with its own feature set.

What You Can Build With Bit Form

Bit Form is more than a basic contact form plugin. You can create many types of WordPress forms for different business, marketing, support, and payment needs. Use Bit Form to create:

  • Contact form for websites, blogs, landing pages, and business sites
  • Lead generation form for collecting prospects and customer details
  • Support form for help desk requests, issue reports, and customer messages
  • Order form for products, services, custom requests, and manual sales
  • Booking form for appointments, events, consultations, and service requests
  • Payment form for collecting payments through PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Mollie
  • Multistep form for longer forms that need a cleaner step-by-step flow
  • Conversational form for a question-by-question experience
  • File upload form for documents, images, resumes, screenshots, and project files
  • Registration form and login form using WordPress authentication
  • Calculator form for quotes, pricing, loan estimates, tax estimates, and custom calculations
  • Feedback form, survey form, application form, donation form, quote form, and onboarding form

Whether you need one simple form or many advanced forms, Bit Form gives you a flexible form plugin that works for real WordPress use cases.

Free Form Integrations

This WordPress form builder plugin includes 50+ free integrations with many platforms. These integrations help you send form data to CRM tools, email marketing tools, spreadsheets, automation platforms, file storage services, messaging apps, WordPress plugins, and webhook-based workflows.

Drag-and-Drop WordPress Form Builder

Bit Form includes an intuitive drag-and-drop form builder. You can add fields, arrange layouts, customize labels, set placeholders, configure validation, apply show hide conditional logic, style your form, and publish it on your WordPress site.

Fast and Lightweight Form Builder

Bit Form is designed to work as a fast form builder for WordPress.

For simple contact forms, Bit Form loads only 20KB JS & CSS. The exact load depends on the fields and settings you use, but the plugin is built to keep form performance clean and lightweight.

Bit Form still handles advanced forms in a well-optimized way. It gives you both: simple form creation for beginners and advanced form control for power users.

Form Settings for Better Control

Bit Form gives you detailed form settings so you can control how your forms behave. Available form settings include:
– Allow single entry for each IP address
– Require users to be logged in before form submission
– Prevent empty form submission
– Validate form input when the field loses focus
– Disable entry storing in the WordPress database
– Enable reCAPTCHA v3
– Enable honeypot spam protection
– Disable a form after a limited number of entries
– Limit form submission by date and time period
– Block or allow selected IP addresses
– Capture Google Ads Click ID or GCLID

Conditional Logic and Dynamic Forms

Bit Form Free includes basic conditional logic to show or hide fields based on user input.

Bit Form Pro adds advanced rules and actions like enable or disable fields, change values, make fields read-only or writable, update labels, update helper text, and control form behavior based on user choices, including AND and OR conditions, groups, nested conditions, Else If branches, and Else branches.

This makes Bit Form useful for quote forms, calculator forms, booking forms, payment forms, order forms, support forms, and advanced lead generation forms, where every user should not see the same fields.

Email Notifications and Email Templates

Bit Form lets you send email notifications after form submission. You can create custom email templates, add smart tags, insert form field values, map all fields into the email body, and send different messages based on form data.

Bit Form Pro also supports advanced email notifications with PDF attachments, giving you more control over documents, receipts, confirmations, and internal records.

Built-in Style Editor

Bit Form includes a built-in style editor so you can customize your form design easily. You can adjust form layout, background, spacing, field style, colors, typography, buttons, and other visual elements to match your WordPress site.

The free version includes essential form styling, while Bit Form Pro adds deeper control with individual field styling.

Payment Forms With PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay and Mollie

Bit Form Pro lets you create payment forms using PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Mollie.

You can build a payment form, order form, booking form, donation form, service request form, event registration form, or custom checkout-style form.

By using payment fields, you can collect payments through a form easily. You can combine payment fields with contact fields, file upload fields, conditional logic, email notifications, and form integrations.

Multistep Forms and Conversational Forms

Long forms can feel hard to complete when everything appears on one screen. Bit Form supports multistep forms, so you can divide longer forms into smaller sections.

Bit Form also supports conversational forms. A conversational form shows questions in a step-by-step flow, which can work well for lead generation, feedback, applications, and guided form experiences.

Entry Management, Data Views, and Reports

Bit Form stores form submissions inside the dashboard.

You can review form entries, manage submitted data, filter responses, and use entry-related features for internal workflows.

With Bit Form Pro, Data Views & Edit lets you control which users can view or edit entries from the front end. You can allow users to view their own entries, allow selected roles to view others’ entries, and create front-end data views for submitted form data.

Landing Forms and Direct Form Sharing

Bit Form Pro supports landing forms and standalone form pages. You can create a form page with its own direct URL and share it without embedding the form on a normal WordPress page.

You can also share conversational form links or embed forms using HTML embed code.

PDF Templates and Attachments

Bit Form Pro supports PDF templates. You can generate PDF files from submitted form data and use them for records, receipts, invoices, contracts, applications, and internal documents.

PDF template options include:

  • Custom PDF template body
  • Form field smart tags
  • Map all fields
  • Custom PDF file name
  • PDF password
  • Download link control
  • Paper size
  • Orientation
  • Font family
  • Font size
  • Watermark
  • Language direction

PDF support is useful for booking forms, order forms, payment forms, application forms, contract forms, and official form records.

Spam Protection and Email Verification

Bit Form includes multiple spam protection options. You can protect forms using reCAPTCHA v2, reCAPTCHA v3, hCaptcha, and Cloudflare Turnstile for free. Honeypot protection is included in Pro.

Bit Form also supports double opt-in in Pro. Double opt-in can require users to confirm their email before selected actions run. This is useful for newsletter forms, lead generation forms, registration forms, and email-based workflows.

Form Abandonment and Partial Entries (Pro)

Bit Form includes form abandonment support. This feature can save partial form data when users leave before completing the form.

You can show a warning message, save drafts for logged-in users, repopulate previous partial entries, save a draft when the user leaves the form page, and allow empty forms to be saved as drafts when needed.

WordPress Authentication Forms

Bit Form Pro includes WordPress authentication features. You can create forms for:

  • User registration
  • User login
  • Forgot password
  • Reset password

You can map form fields to WordPress user fields, assign user roles, set approval methods, send user and admin notifications, redirect users after submission, and map user meta fields.

This makes Bit Form useful for membership sites, course sites, private communities, customer portals, and user onboarding flows.

Why Choose Bit Form?

Bit Form gives you a clean form-building experience without making the workflow feel complicated. Bit Form is useful for:

  • Beginners who want to create a contact form without code
  • Small businesses that need lead generation forms and support forms
  • Agencies that build forms for client websites
  • Freelancers who need booking forms, quote forms, and order forms
  • Membership sites that need registration, login, and user forms
  • Marketers who need CRM, email marketing, and automation integrations
  • Developers who need conditional logic, webhooks, PDF output, and custom JS/CSS control

Bit Form keeps simple form creation easy while still giving advanced users enough control to build complex form workflows.

Build Simple Forms or Advanced Form Workflows

You can start with a basic form and later build more complex forms with file upload, conditional logic, multistep form, conversational form, payment form fields, booking form workflows, order form confirmations, support form notifications, CRM integrations, and PDF attachments.

Bit Form gives you a flexible form-building system inside WordPress with a beginner-friendly interface and advanced form-building capabilities.

External services

Bit Form connects to external services only when:
– You enable a specific integration (e.g., Zoho CRM, Mailchimp, Google Sheets)
– You use a built-in feature that requires external processing (e.g., spam protection, icon search)

Data is sent to external servers only when integrations are active (captcha/icon search are exceptions when those features are used). Enabling an integration sends form data to that service per your configuration — for example, connecting Mailchimp will send subscriber data on form submission.

For a full reference with additional details see: External Services
sections.installation:
1. Download the Bit Form plugin.
  2. Upload the Bit Form plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bit-form directory, or from the WordPress Admin Panel, click on Plugins => Add New to install Bit Form directly.
  3. Click on Upload, so you can directly upload the Bit Form zip file.
  4. Use the browse button to select the plugin zip file that was downloaded, and then click on Install Now.
  5. Once installed, click “Activate” to enjoy the best form building experience ever.
sections.faq:
Can I build advanced forms with Bit Form?

Yes. Bit Form supports conditional logic, calculations, multistep forms, conversational forms, file uploads, email templates, form entries, integrations, and advanced Pro features.

Does Bit Form support payment forms?

Yes. Bit Form Pro supports payment forms with PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Mollie. You can create order forms, booking forms, donation forms, and service payment forms.

Can I create multistep forms?

Yes. Bit Form supports multistep forms, so you can split long forms into smaller steps for applications, bookings, registrations, quotes, and payment forms.

Can users upload files through Bit Form?

Yes. Bit Form includes a file upload field in the free version. Bit Form Pro adds advanced file upload controls for more complex form workflows.

Does Bit Form include spam protection?

Yes. Bit Form supports reCAPTCHA v2, reCAPTCHA v3, hCaptcha, and Cloudflare Turnstile. Bit Form Pro also includes honeypot spam protection.

Does Bit Form Free show form entries?

Yes. Bit Form free version shows form submissions inside WordPress, so you can view and manage entries from your dashboard. You can also disable database entry storage when needed.

Are Bit Form integrations free?

Yes. Bit Form includes 50+ free integrations for CRM, email marketing, automation, spreadsheets, storage, messaging, WooCommerce, webhooks, and other workflow tools.

Does Bit Form work with page builders?

Yes. You can use Bit Form with WordPress pages, posts, shortcodes, Gutenberg, and popular page builders that support shortcode or block-based form placement.

Will Bit Form slow down my website?

Bit Form is built as a lightweight form builder. For simple contact forms, it loads only the required assets, so your forms stay fast and clean.

Can I build multi-column forms?

Yes, Bit Form supports multi-column form layouts. You can place fields side by side, adjust the form structure, and create cleaner layouts for contact forms, booking forms, order forms, registration forms, and other advanced forms.

Can I export/import form submission data?

Yes, you can export form submission data from Bit Form entries for reporting, backup, or external use.
sections.changelog:
3.2.2

  • Release Date: 3rd August, 2026

  • Improvements:

    1. Bit Form Pro Updates: Improved the “Update Now” flow for updating Bit Form Pro from the plugins screen.

  • Fixes:

    1. Multi-Step Forms: Fixed the form freezing when “Next” was clicked after a successful submission — validation repeated until it failed, so a second entry could not be started without reloading the page.
    2. File Uploads to Integrations: Fixed uploaded files not reaching OneDrive and Dropbox (“Can’t open or read file!”) and being silently skipped by WooCommerce and the Zoho integrations (CRM, Bigin, Creator, Desk, Mail, Projects, Recruit, and WorkDrive).
    3. OneDrive: Fixed the same file being uploaded more than once when a form mapped several file fields to the integration.
    4. Bit CRM Integration: Fixed missing tag titles when a form was created from Bit CRM.

3.2.1

  • Release Date: 28 July, 2026

  • New:

    1. Bit CRM Integration: Added Bit CRM as a form integration, so submissions can create and tag leads in Bit CRM automatically.

  • Improvements:

    1. Cache Plugin Compatibility: The post-load security token is now generated by default on sites that have never changed the setting, so forms keep working behind full-page caching.
    2. Entry Editing: Improved the entry edit screen and its save/update flow in the admin.

  • Fixes:

    1. Email From Name: Fixed the “From Name” configured on an email notification being ignored — notifications fell back to the sender address instead. Emails will now show the name you configured.
    2. Entry Editing: Fixed the error message not being shown when an admin entry update failed.
    3. File Uploads: Fixed a fatal error when a File Upload field inside a Repeater submitted more than one file.
    4. Error Log: Stopped writing unnecessary entries to the WordPress debug log on every form submission.
    5. Data Accuracy: Fixed a failed database query returning the previous query’s rows instead of reporting the error, which could show the wrong records on a page.

  • Security:

    1. Hardened the database query layer so a query condition can never contribute an unrecognised column name or comparison operator to a statement.
    2. Sanitized form submissions made through internal field keys, closing a stored cross-site-scripting and PDF request-forgery path.
    3. Our thanks to security researchers Artus KG, JING QIAN and Farid Narimanov for responsibly disclosing the issues addressed in this release.

3.2.0

  • Release Date: 20 July, 2026

  • New:

    1. After Submit Behavior: Added a new setting to control the form behavior after submission (Hide Form, Reset Form, or Keep Form Values).
    2. Active Status Toggle: Added an enable/disable toggle for Success Message, Redirect URL, Email Notification, PDF Template, and Integration settings.
    3. WordPress Media Library Attachments: Added an option to select files from the WordPress Media Library as email attachments in the Email Notification settings.
    4. Individual Conditional Logic (Pro): Added support for enabling or disabling conditional logic for individual features (Success Message, Redirect URL, Email Notification, and Integrations).
    5. Conditional Email Routing (Pro): Added support for conditional routing in the “Send To Email” setting of Email Notifications.
    6. PDF Header & Footer (Pro): Added editors for configuring PDF headers and footers in the PDF Template settings.

  • Improvements:

    1. Execution Process: Decoupled the execution of Success Messages, Redirect URLs, Email Notifications, and Integrations from the central conditional logic. Each feature can now execute independently and be controlled individually.
    2. Success Message: Redesigned the UI/UX and improved the execution workflow for a better user experience.
    3. Email Templates: Added Configuration Info and Status columns to the list table, redesigned the editor UI/UX for improved usability, and enhanced the email execution workflow.
    4. Email Configuration: Added configuration options for To, CC, BCC, From Name, From Email, Reply-To Email, and Attachments. Also added support for attaching multiple PDF(Pro) templates to email notifications.
    5. PDF Templates (Pro): Added PDF Name and Settings Info columns to the list table and redesigned the editor UI/UX for improved usability and management.

  • Fixes:

    1. Field Cloning: Fixed a name property conflict when cloning composite fields with child fields.
    2. Submission Validation: Fixed an issue where validation errors were not displayed when a required field existed in the field list but was missing from the form layout.
    3. Conditional Record Edit Action: Fixed an issue where conditional logic configured for the “On Record Edit” action was not executed correctly during entry updates.

3.1.4

  • Release Date: 13 July, 2026
  • Improvements:
    1. Enhanced security by adding missing output escaping in the Conversational Form view to help prevent potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.

  • Improvements:

    1. Added a setting to show or hide the search input in Dropdown fields.
    2. Improved handling of previously uploaded files during entry updates.

  • Fixes:

    1. Fixed an escaping issue during redirect URL parameter value sanitization.
    2. Fixed inconsistent behavior when saving partial form progress in Form Abandonment.

3.1.2

  • Release Date: 7th July, 2026
  • Fixes:
    1. Hardened file upload entry updates to prevent path traversal from deleting arbitrary files through the file field “_old” value.
    2. Restricted file deletion to files that remain inside the entry upload directory and belong to the current entry metadata.
    3. Inactive Form entry submission: Fixed an issue where inactive forms were still accepting submissions.

3.1.1

  • Release Date: 18 June, 2026

3.1.0

  • Improvements:

    2. Sensitive Data Handling: Improved frontend handling of sensitive data to help prevent potential data exposure.

Bit Form Pro is designed for users who need advanced form control, payment collection, user authentication, form abandonment, PDF generation, and more flexible entry management. Bit Form Pro includes:

  • Advanced multi-step form controls

Note: Bit Form Pro is distributed separately from this plugin. The free version of Bit Form is fully functional with its own feature set.

What You Can Build With Bit Form

Bit Form is more than a basic contact form plugin. You can create many types of WordPress forms for different business, marketing, support, and payment needs. Use Bit Form to create:

  • Contact form for websites, blogs, landing pages, and business sites
  • Lead generation form for collecting prospects and customer details
  • Support form for help desk requests, issue reports, and customer messages
  • Order form for products, services, custom requests, and manual sales
  • Booking form for appointments, events, consultations, and service requests
  • Payment form for collecting payments through PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Mollie
  • Multistep form for longer forms that need a cleaner step-by-step flow
  • Conversational form for a question-by-question experience
  • File upload form for documents, images, resumes, screenshots, and project files
  • Registration form and login form using WordPress authentication
  • Calculator form for quotes, pricing, loan estimates, tax estimates, and custom calculations
  • Feedback form, survey form, application form, donation form, quote form, and onboarding form

Whether you need one simple form or many advanced forms, Bit Form gives you a flexible form plugin that works for real WordPress use cases.

Drag-and-Drop WordPress Form Builder

Bit Form includes an intuitive drag-and-drop form builder. You can add fields, arrange layouts, customize labels, set placeholders, configure validation, apply show hide conditional logic, style your form, and publish it on your WordPress site.

Fast and Lightweight Form Builder

Bit Form is designed to work as a fast form builder for WordPress.

For simple contact forms, Bit Form loads only 20KB JS & CSS. The exact load depends on the fields and settings you use, but the plugin is built to keep form performance clean and lightweight.

Bit Form still handles advanced forms in a well-optimized way. It gives you both: simple form creation for beginners and advanced form control for power users.

Form Settings for Better Control

Bit Form gives you detailed form settings so you can control how your forms behave. Available form settings include:
– Allow single entry for each IP address
– Require users to be logged in before form submission
– Prevent empty form submission
– Validate form input when the field loses focus
– Disable entry storing in the WordPress database
– Enable reCAPTCHA v3
– Enable honeypot spam protection
– Disable a form after a limited number of entries
– Limit form submission by date and time period
– Block or allow selected IP addresses
– Capture Google Ads Click ID or GCLID

Conditional Logic and Dynamic Forms

Bit Form Free includes basic conditional logic to show or hide fields based on user input.

Bit Form Pro adds advanced rules and actions like enable or disable fields, change values, make fields read-only or writable, update labels, update helper text, and control form behavior based on user choices, including AND and OR conditions, groups, nested conditions, Else If branches, and Else branches.

This makes Bit Form useful for quote forms, calculator forms, booking forms, payment forms, order forms, support forms, and advanced lead generation forms, where every user should not see the same fields.

Email Notifications and Email Templates

Bit Form lets you send email notifications after form submission. You can create custom email templates, add smart tags, insert form field values, map all fields into the email body, and send different messages based on form data.

Bit Form Pro also supports advanced email notifications with PDF attachments, giving you more control over documents, receipts, confirmations, and internal records.

Built-in Style Editor

Bit Form includes a built-in style editor so you can customize your form design easily. You can adjust form layout, background, spacing, field style, colors, typography, buttons, and other visual elements to match your WordPress site.

The free version includes essential form styling, while Bit Form Pro adds deeper control with individual field styling.

Payment Forms With PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay and Mollie

Bit Form Pro lets you create payment forms using PayPal, Stripe, Razorpay, and Mollie.

You can build a payment form, order form, booking form, donation form, service request form, event registration form, or custom checkout-style form.

By using payment fields, you can collect payments through a form easily. You can combine payment fields with contact fields, file upload fields, conditional logic, email notifications, and form integrations.

Multistep Forms and Conversational Forms

Long forms can feel hard to complete when everything appears on one screen. Bit Form supports multistep forms, so you can divide longer forms into smaller sections.

Bit Form also supports conversational forms. A conversational form shows questions in a step-by-step flow, which can work well for lead generation, feedback, applications, and guided form experiences.

Entry Management, Data Views, and Reports

Bit Form stores form submissions inside the dashboard.

You can review form entries, manage submitted data, filter responses, and use entry-related features for internal workflows.

With Bit Form Pro, Data Views & Edit lets you control which users can view or edit entries from the front end. You can allow users to view their own entries, allow selected roles to view others’ entries, and create front-end data views for submitted form data.

Landing Forms and Direct Form Sharing

Bit Form Pro supports landing forms and standalone form pages. You can create a form page with its own direct URL and share it without embedding the form on a normal WordPress page.

You can also share conversational form links or embed forms using HTML embed code.

PDF Templates and Attachments

Bit Form Pro supports PDF templates. You can generate PDF files from submitted form data and use them for records, receipts, invoices, contracts, applications, and internal documents.

PDF template options include:

  • Custom PDF template body
  • Form field smart tags
  • Map all fields
  • Custom PDF file name
  • PDF password
  • Download link control
  • Paper size
  • Orientation
  • Font family
  • Font size
  • Watermark
  • Language direction

PDF support is useful for booking forms, order forms, payment forms, application forms, contract forms, and official form records.

Spam Protection and Email Verification

Bit Form includes multiple spam protection options. You can protect forms using reCAPTCHA v2, reCAPTCHA v3, hCaptcha, and Cloudflare Turnstile for free. Honeypot protection is included in Pro.

Bit Form also supports double opt-in in Pro. Double opt-in can require users to confirm their email before selected actions run. This is useful for newsletter forms, lead generation forms, registration forms, and email-based workflows.

Form Abandonment and Partial Entries (Pro)

Bit Form includes form abandonment support. This feature can save partial form data when users leave before completing the form.

You can show a warning message, save drafts for logged-in users, repopulate previous partial entries, save a draft when the user leaves the form page, and allow empty forms to be saved as drafts when needed.

WordPress Authentication Forms

Bit Form Pro includes WordPress authentication features. You can create forms for:

  • User registration
  • User login
  • Forgot password
  • Reset password

You can map form fields to WordPress user fields, assign user roles, set approval methods, send user and admin notifications, redirect users after submission, and map user meta fields.

This makes Bit Form useful for membership sites, course sites, private communities, customer portals, and user onboarding flows.

Why Choose Bit Form?

Bit Form gives you a clean form-building experience without making the workflow feel complicated. Bit Form is useful for:

  • Beginners who want to create a contact form without code
  • Small businesses that need lead generation forms and support forms
  • Agencies that build forms for client websites
  • Freelancers who need booking forms, quote forms, and order forms
  • Membership sites that need registration, login, and user forms
  • Marketers who need CRM, email marketing, and automation integrations
  • Developers who need conditional logic, webhooks, PDF output, and custom JS/CSS control

Bit Form keeps simple form creation easy while still giving advanced users enough control to build complex form workflows.

Build Simple Forms or Advanced Form Workflows

You can start with a basic form and later build more complex forms with file upload, conditional logic, multistep form, conversational form, payment form fields, booking form workflows, order form confirmations, support form notifications, CRM integrations, and PDF attachments.

Bit Form gives you a flexible form-building system inside WordPress with a beginner-friendly interface and advanced form-building capabilities.

External services

Bit Form connects to external services only when:
– You enable a specific integration (e.g., Zoho CRM, Mailchimp, Google Sheets)
– You use a built-in feature that requires external processing (e.g., spam protection, icon search)

Data is sent to external servers only when integrations are active (captcha/icon search are exceptions when those features are used). Enabling an integration sends form data to that service per your configuration — for example, connecting Mailchimp will send subscriber data on form submission.

For a full reference with additional details see: External Services
